intent: An ancient Grashan priestess's ceremonial gown in pale ruin stone, sun gold, faded terracotta and plains green: a high stepped ziggurat crown, a fitted gold-belted bodice and a stiff bell skirt that reads from the high camera as a tall crown over a pinched waist and a wide, gold-banded hem.
reason: Terracotta bell: the run's best skirt, a clean A-line flaring from a belted waist that holds on the slim avatar, under a stepped ziggurat crown; its sleeves are the slimmest in the run (the blue at the shoulders is the preview dummy's bare upper arm) (5.85, second; first critic 6.68, first).
first_fix: Put a slim pale under-sleeve on the upper arm so the avatar doesn't show, lighten the terracotta and add a pale hem band; the back is plain dark grey.
